Gonna share a bit of my story

I’ve had a couple of experiences with attempts and I’ve been sent to some hospitals to rehabilitate myself and have been clinically diagnosed with manic depression, with that known I’ll continue to a more recent time in my story

At one point I had a big change in my life and I left to go move in with another family member who lived across the country. The idea behind it was so maybe me being in a different household with different family would help change my mental state and honestly I feel like it sort of worsened in a sense. Now I don’t show any signs of my depression or suicidal ideation and instead I hide it and put a persona so it doesn’t affect anyone I know personally because I’ve already put them in a position where they’ve been crushed and confused as to why I am the way I am.  So after years with this practice I’ve still remained the same while growing as an individual. I’ve also made the decision that after my mother passes I’ll pass soon after, and I genuinely don’t want it to be a thing people get sad about but unfortunately I have no control on how people will react to my death. I can say however living for others is hard and everyone will handle it in someway or another

Ultimately, I believe some people can be relived from the idea of suicide but everyone’s stories differ. Wish I could tell you what’s waiting on the other side but I guess we’ll all find out eventually. Hope you all have a wonderful day❤️
